# Run: `r params$date_label`

**Directory:** `r params$run_dir`

## Data Loading

```{r load-plate}
# Find the plate config CSV (starts with "ddplate" on line 1)
all_csvs <- list.files(params$run_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
plate_csv <- NULL
for (f in all_csvs) {
  first_line <- readLines(f, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
  if (grepl("^ddplate", first_line)) {
    plate_csv <- f
    break
  }
}

if (!is.null(plate_csv)) {
  plate <- data.table::fread(plate_csv, skip = 4)
  plate <- plate %>% dplyr::distinct(Well, .keep_all = TRUE)
} else {
  # Fallback: look for plate.csv
  plate_path <- file.path(params$run_dir, "plate.csv")
  if (file.exists(plate_path)) {
    plate <- data.table::fread(plate_path, skip = 4)
    plate <- plate %>% dplyr::distinct(Well, .keep_all = TRUE)
  } else {
    stop("No plate metadata CSV found in run directory.")
  }
}
```

```{r load-amplitude}
files <- list.files(params$run_dir, pattern = "_Amplitude\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read all amplitude files
amp_list <- lapply(files, function(y) {
  df <- data.table::fread(y, skip = 4)
  df <- df[, 1:4, with = FALSE]
  # Explicitly name columns (fread may auto-name as V1-V4)
  names(df) <- c("Ch1Amplitude", "Ch2Amplitude", params$y_target, params$x_target)
  # Force numeric
  df$Ch1Amplitude <- as.numeric(df$Ch1Amplitude)
  df$Ch2Amplitude <- as.numeric(df$Ch2Amplitude)
  df[[3]] <- as.numeric(df[[3]])
  df[[4]] <- as.numeric(df[[4]])
  return(df)
})
names(amp_list) <- basename(files)

# Process: rename targets to canonical Y/X, extract well, classify droplets
amp_list <- lapply(seq_along(amp_list), function(x) {
  df <- amp_list[[x]]

  # Skip empty wells (no droplet data)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Rename target columns to canonical Y and X
  y_col <- which(names(df) == params$y_target)
  x_col <- which(names(df) == params$x_target)
  if (length(y_col) == 1) names(df)[y_col] <- "Y"
  if (length(x_col) == 1) names(df)[x_col] <- "X"

  # Classify droplets
  df$call <- ifelse(df$X == 0 & df$Y == 1, "Y+",
             ifelse(df$X == 1 & df$Y == 0, "Y-",
             ifelse(df$X == 1 & df$Y == 1, "X+Y", "empty")))

  # Extract well ID dynamically (find element matching well pattern)
  parts <- str_split(basename(files)[x], "_", simplify = TRUE)
  well_idx <- which(grepl("^[A-H][0-9]{2}$", parts))
  if (length(well_idx) > 0) {
    df$well <- parts[well_idx[length(well_idx)]]  # take last match (closest to _Amplitude)
  } else {
    df$well <- paste0("W", x)
  }

  return(df)
})

# Remove NULL (empty wells) and bind
amp_list <- amp_list[!sapply(amp_list, is.null)]
l <- data.table::rbindlist(amp_list)
l <- l %>% tidyr::drop_na(call)

# Ensure numeric types
l$Ch1Amplitude <- as.numeric(l$Ch1Amplitude)
l$Ch2Amplitude <- as.numeric(l$Ch2Amplitude)
l$Y <- as.numeric(l$Y)
l$X <- as.numeric(l$X)

cat(sprintf("Loaded %d droplets across %d wells\n", nrow(l), length(unique(l$well))))
cat(sprintf("Ch1 class: %s | Ch2 class: %s\n", class(l$Ch1Amplitude), class(l$Ch2Amplitude)))
cat(sprintf("Ch1 range: %.1f - %.1f | Ch2 range: %.1f - %.1f\n",
    min(l$Ch1Amplitude, na.rm = TRUE), max(l$Ch1Amplitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    min(l$Ch2Amplitude, na.rm = TRUE), max(l$Ch2Amplitude, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("Ch1 NAs: %d | Ch2 NAs: %d\n", sum(is.na(l$Ch1Amplitude)), sum(is.na(l$Ch2Amplitude))))
cat(sprintf("Call distribution: %s\n", paste(names(table(l$call)), table(l$call), sep = "=", collapse = ", ")))
```

## Droplet Classification & Ratios

```{r classify}
# Aggregate droplet counts per well/sample
counts <- l %>%
  dplyr::group_by(name, `Sample description 1`, call, TargetName) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  reshape2::dcast(name + TargetName ~ call, value.var = "n")
counts[is.na(counts)] <- 0

# Ensure all call columns exist
for (col in c("Y+", "Y-", "X+Y", "empty")) {
  if (!(col %in% names(counts))) counts[[col]] <- 0
}

# Extract well and sample description from name (format: "WELL_SAMPLEDESC")
counts$well <- str_split(counts$name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]
counts$sample_desc <- sub("^[A-H][0-9]{2}_", "", counts$name)

# Extract cell line (first part of sample description before _)
first_field <- str_split(counts$sample_desc, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]
counts$cell_line <- ifelse(grepl("^(P[1-4]|D0)", first_field),
                           "HT1080", first_field)

# Calculate ratios
counts <- counts %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ratio      = (`Y+` + `X+Y`) / (`Y-` + `X+Y`),
    total      = `Y+` + `Y-` + `X+Y` + empty,
    empty_rate = empty / total,
    double_rate = `X+Y` / total
  )

counts$date <- params$date_label
```

```{r ratio-table}
counts %>%
  dplyr::select(name, cell_line, TargetName, ratio, empty_rate, double_rate, total) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Droplet-count ratios and QC metrics per well")
```

### Pooled Replicates

Technical replicate wells are pooled by summing raw droplet counts before computing ratios (weighted by droplet count per well).

```{r pool-replicates}
# Pool replicate wells: sum droplet counts by sample_desc (e.g., LNCAP_LOY)
pooled <- counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_desc, cell_line) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_wells  = dplyr::n(),
    wells    = paste(well, collapse = "+"),
    `Y+`     = sum(`Y+`),
    `Y-`     = sum(`Y-`),
    `X+Y`    = sum(`X+Y`),
    empty    = sum(empty),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total       = `Y+` + `Y-` + `X+Y` + empty,
    ratio       = (`Y+` + `X+Y`) / (`Y-` + `X+Y`),
    empty_rate  = empty / total,
    double_rate = `X+Y` / total
  )

# Extract condition — remap LOY to LOYx2 (2nd nucleofection)
pooled$condition <- sub("^[^_]+_", "", pooled$sample_desc)
pooled$condition <- ifelse(pooled$condition == "LOY", "LOYx2", pooled$condition)

pooled %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_desc, wells, n_wells, cell_line, ratio, empty_rate, double_rate, total) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Pooled replicate ratios (raw droplet counts summed across wells)")
```

## QC Metrics

```{r qc-metrics, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
qc_long <- counts %>%
  dplyr::select(name, cell_line, empty_rate, double_rate, total) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

# Panel 1: rates
qc_rates <- qc_long %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(empty_rate, double_rate),
                      names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(metric = ifelse(metric == "empty_rate", "Empty Rate", "Double Rate"))

p1 <- ggbarplot(qc_rates, x = "name", y = "value", fill = "metric",
                position = position_dodge(), palette = c("#3C5488", "#E64B35")) %>%
  ggpar(x.text.angle = 45, font.x = c(7), ylab = "Rate", xlab = "",
        title = "Empty & Double Rates", legend.title = "Metric")

# Panel 2: total droplets
p2 <- ggbarplot(qc_long, x = "name", y = "total", fill = "cell_line",
                palette = "aaas") %>%
  ggpar(x.text.angle = 45, font.x = c(7), ylab = "Accepted Droplets", xlab = "",
        title = "Total Droplets per Well", legend.title = "Cell line")

ggarrange(p1, p2, nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1))
```

```{r concentration-calc, eval=has_dt}
# Pivot concentration data
dt_conc <- dt %>%
  dplyr::select(name, Target, `Conc(copies/µL)`, PoissonConfMax, PoissonConfMin)

conc_wide <- reshape2::dcast(dt_conc, name ~ Target, value.var = "Conc(copies/µL)")
ci_max <- reshape2::dcast(dt_conc, name ~ Target, value.var = "PoissonConfMax")
ci_min <- reshape2::dcast(dt_conc, name ~ Target, value.var = "PoissonConfMin")

# Rename dynamically
targets <- setdiff(names(conc_wide), "name")
names(conc_wide)[-1] <- paste0(targets, "_Conc")
names(ci_max)[-1] <- paste0(targets, "_PoissonConfMax")
names(ci_min)[-1] <- paste0(targets, "_PoissonConfMin")

conc_all <- dplyr::left_join(conc_wide, ci_max, by = "name") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ci_min, by = "name")

# Make numeric
for (col in names(conc_all)[-1]) {
  conc_all[[col]] <- as.numeric(conc_all[[col]])
}

# Determine which target pairs exist and compute ratios
# Y-linked target conc / X-linked target conc
y_conc_col <- paste0(params$y_target, "_Conc")
x_conc_col <- paste0(params$x_target, "_Conc")

if (all(c(y_conc_col, x_conc_col) %in% names(conc_all))) {
  conc_all$Conc_ratio <- conc_all[[y_conc_col]] / conc_all[[x_conc_col]]
  conc_all$CI_max <- conc_all[[paste0(params$y_target, "_PoissonConfMax")]] /
                     conc_all[[x_conc_col]]
  conc_all$CI_min <- conc_all[[paste0(params$y_target, "_PoissonConfMin")]] /
                     conc_all[[x_conc_col]]
}

# Also check for DDX3Y/RNaseP
if (all(c("DDX3Y_Conc", "RNaseP_Conc") %in% names(conc_all))) {
  conc_all$DDX3Y_ratio <- conc_all$DDX3Y_Conc / conc_all$RNaseP_Conc
}

# Join concentration data to counts
counts <- dplyr::left_join(counts, conc_all, by = "name")
```

```{r concentration-plot, eval=has_dt, fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
if ("Conc_ratio" %in% names(conc_all)) {
  conc_plot <- conc_all %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(Conc_ratio) & is.finite(Conc_ratio))

  if (nrow(conc_plot) > 0) {
    # Add sample metadata
    conc_plot$well <- str_split(conc_plot$name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]
    conc_plot$sample_desc <- sub("^[A-H][0-9]{2}_", "", conc_plot$name)
    conc_plot$condition <- sub("^[^_]+_", "", conc_plot$sample_desc)
    conc_plot$condition <- ifelse(conc_plot$condition == "LOY", "LOYx2", conc_plot$condition)
    conc_plot$cell_line <- str_split(conc_plot$sample_desc, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]
    conc_plot$sample_label <- paste0(conc_plot$sample_desc, " (", conc_plot$well, ")")

    # Per-well plot
    ggplot(conc_plot, aes(x = sample_label, y = Conc_ratio, fill = condition)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.6) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_min, ymax = CI_max), width = 0.2) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("LOYx2" = "#E64B35", "sgCTRL" = "#4DBBD5")) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Concentration Ratio per Well —", params$date_label),
        subtitle = paste0(params$y_label, " / ", params$x_label, " (copies/\u00b5L)"),
        y = "Concentration Ratio", x = "", fill = "Condition"
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(conc_plot$CI_max, 1.05, na.rm = TRUE))) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8))
  }
}
```

## Historical Comparison

```{r historical, fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
if (file.exists(params$summary_csv)) {
  hist_data <- data.table::fread(params$summary_csv)

  # Cell lines in current run
  current_cell_lines <- unique(counts$cell_line)

  # Filter historical to matching cell lines
  hist_filtered <- hist_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(cell_line %in% current_cell_lines)

  if (nrow(hist_filtered) > 0) {
    # Standardize TargetName for historical data
    hist_filtered$target_pair <- ifelse(hist_filtered$TargetName == "AMELY", "AMELY/AMELX",
                                 ifelse(hist_filtered$TargetName == "DDX3Y", "DDX3Y/RNaseP",
                                        hist_filtered$TargetName))

    # Prepare historical data for plot
    hist_for_plot <- hist_filtered %>%
      dplyr::select(name, cell_line, ratio, target_pair, ddPCR_date) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(source = "Historical")

    # Prepare current run data (use pooled replicates)
    current_for_hist <- pooled %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        target_pair = "AMELY/AMELX",
        ddPCR_date = params$date_label,
        source = "Current Run"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(name = sample_desc, cell_line, ratio, target_pair, ddPCR_date, source)

    combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(hist_for_plot, current_for_hist)

    # Create sample label (name + date)
    combined$label <- paste0(combined$name, "\n(", combined$ddPCR_date, ")")

    # Plot all cell lines in current run, faceted by target pair and cell line
    ggplot(combined, aes(x = reorder(label, -ratio), y = ratio, fill = source)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.6, position = position_dodge(0.7)) +
      facet_grid(target_pair ~ cell_line, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Current Run" = "#E64B35", "Historical" = "#4DBBD5")) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
      labs(
        title = "Historical Comparison of Y/X Ratio",
        y = "Ratio", x = "", fill = ""
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.1)) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
  } else {
    cat("No historical data found for cell lines in this run:",
        paste(current_cell_lines, collapse = ", "))
  }
} else {
  cat("Summary CSV not found at:", params$summary_csv)
}
```

### LNCaP Historical Detail

```{r historical-lncap, fig.height=6, fig.width=9}
if (file.exists(params$summary_csv)) {
  hist_data <- data.table::fread(params$summary_csv)

  # All LNCaP entries from summary
  hist_lncap <- hist_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("LNCAP", cell_line, ignore.case = TRUE))

  if (nrow(hist_lncap) > 0) {
    hist_lncap$target_pair <- ifelse(hist_lncap$TargetName == "AMELY", "AMELY/AMELX",
                              ifelse(hist_lncap$TargetName == "DDX3Y", "DDX3Y/RNaseP",
                                     hist_lncap$TargetName))

    # Standardize condition names for historical data
    # CP+Q53+P47 = LOYx1 (first nucleofection)
    # CTRL1 / LNCAP_CTRL = sgCTRL
    # Parental = Parental
    hist_lncap$condition <- dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("CP\\+Q53\\+P47", hist_lncap$name) ~ "LOYx1",
      grepl("CTRL", hist_lncap$name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "sgCTRL",
      grepl("Parental", hist_lncap$name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Parental",
      TRUE ~ hist_lncap$name
    )

    hist_lncap_plot <- hist_lncap %>%
      dplyr::select(name, ratio, target_pair, ddPCR_date, condition) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(source = "Historical")

    # Current LNCaP data (use pooled replicates)
    # LNCAP_LOY in Feb 2026 = LOYx2 (second nucleofection)
    current_lncap <- pooled %>%
      dplyr::filter(grepl("LNCAP", cell_line, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        target_pair = "AMELY/AMELX",
        ddPCR_date = params$date_label,
        source = "Current Run",
        condition = dplyr::case_when(
          grepl("LOY", sample_desc, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "LOYx2",
          grepl("sgCTRL|CTRL", sample_desc, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "sgCTRL",
          TRUE ~ sample_desc
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(name = sample_desc, ratio, target_pair, ddPCR_date, condition, source)

    lncap_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(hist_lncap_plot, current_lncap)

    # Order conditions logically: Parental > sgCTRL > LOYx1 > LOYx2
    lncap_combined$condition <- factor(lncap_combined$condition,
      levels = c("Parental", "sgCTRL", "LOYx1", "LOYx2"))

    lncap_combined$label <- paste0(lncap_combined$condition, "\n(", lncap_combined$ddPCR_date, ")")

    # Bar plot: condition on x-axis, colored by date, faceted by target pair
    ggplot(lncap_combined, aes(x = condition, y = ratio, fill = ddPCR_date)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.6, position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single", padding = 0.1)) +
      facet_wrap(~ target_pair, scales = "free_x") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
      labs(
        title = "LNCaP — Y Chromosome Loss Across Runs",
        subtitle = "Parental \u2192 sgCTRL \u2192 LOYx1 (1st nucleofection) \u2192 LOYx2 (2nd nucleofection)",
        y = "Ratio", x = "Condition", fill = "ddPCR Date"
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.1)) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
  } else {
    cat("No LNCaP historical data found in summary CSV.")
  }
} else {
  cat("Summary CSV not found at:", params$summary_csv)
}
```

### Nucleofection Efficacy — Fold Change vs sgCTRL

```{r fold-change, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
if (exists("lncap_combined")) {
  # Average ratio per condition x target_pair (collapse across dates)
  fc_data <- lncap_combined %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(condition)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(condition, target_pair) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_ratio = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # Compute fold change relative to sgCTRL for each target pair
  fc_table <- fc_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(target_pair) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sgCTRL_ratio = mean_ratio[condition == "sgCTRL"],
      fold_vs_ctrl = mean_ratio / sgCTRL_ratio,
      pct_reduction = (1 - fold_vs_ctrl) * 100
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # Also compute LOYx2 vs LOYx1 improvement where both exist
  fc_table <- fc_table %>%
    dplyr::group_by(target_pair) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      LOYx1_ratio = ifelse(any(condition == "LOYx1"), mean_ratio[condition == "LOYx1"], NA_real_),
      fold_x2_vs_x1 = ifelse(condition == "LOYx2" & !is.na(LOYx1_ratio),
                              mean_ratio / LOYx1_ratio, NA_real_),
      pct_further_reduction = ifelse(condition == "LOYx2" & !is.na(LOYx1_ratio),
                                     (1 - fold_x2_vs_x1) * 100, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # Display table
  fc_table %>%
    dplyr::select(target_pair, condition, mean_ratio, sgCTRL_ratio,
                  fold_vs_ctrl, pct_reduction, fold_x2_vs_x1, pct_further_reduction) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
    knitr::kable(
      caption = "Fold change relative to sgCTRL and LOYx2 vs LOYx1 improvement",
      col.names = c("Target Pair", "Condition", "Mean Ratio", "sgCTRL Ratio",
                     "Fold vs sgCTRL", "% Reduction vs sgCTRL",
                     "Fold LOYx2/LOYx1", "% Further Reduction")
    )
}
```

```{r fold-change-plot, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
if (exists("fc_table")) {
  fc_plot <- fc_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(condition %in% c("LOYx1", "LOYx2"))

  if (nrow(fc_plot) > 0) {
    fc_plot$condition <- factor(fc_plot$condition, levels = c("LOYx1", "LOYx2"))

    ggplot(fc_plot, aes(x = condition, y = pct_reduction, fill = condition)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.5, position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single", padding = 0.1)) +
      geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct_reduction, 1), "%")),
                vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
      facet_wrap(~ target_pair) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("LOYx1" = "#F39B7F", "LOYx2" = "#E64B35")) +
      labs(
        title = "LNCaP — Y Chromosome Reduction vs sgCTRL",
        subtitle = "% reduction in AMELY/AMELX ratio after each nucleofection",
        y = "% Reduction vs sgCTRL", x = "Condition", fill = ""
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 110)) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "none",
            strip.text = element_text(size = 10))
  }
}
```
